name: Gützkow (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over yellow, charged at the centre with the city arms of Gützkow (a red saltire between roses on white, crowned with a city wall).
history: Municipal flag of Gützkow; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Gützkow arms — saltire and roses with mural crown
